truth_notice.en: These Level 3 extension sessions are newly authored for StreetGym.

description.en: Resume after the assigned recovery with controlled assisted turnovers, strict basics, and the listed regression at the first unclean repetition.
Build the front line through timed tucks and rows, using each listed regression as soon as the pelvis drops or the elbows lose position.
Pair measured forward lean and pressing with single-leg strength; use the listed regression whenever wrist comfort or bodyline quality changes.
Use low-dose back-lever entries and dragon negatives as restorative technique, applying the listed regression before any shoulder or trunk strain.
Rebuild the basic pull, dip, push, squat, and hanging-core patterns with fixed submaximal sets and each listed regression at form loss.
Complete one concise dose for every goal in sequence, retain the foundational push-up, and use the listed regression immediately whenever a shape or turnover is not clean.
Accumulate four clean muscle-up pairs before balanced pulling, support, and leg work; use the listed regression at the first slow transition.
Build longer advanced-tuck front-lever holds, then complete the listed rows, pulls, and core work with prescribed regressions.
Move from frog balance to measured leans and pressing, keeping the assigned leg work and using the listed regression at any wrist or bodyline change.

Restore shoulder range while rehearsing low-dose back-lever and dragon positions, applying the listed regression before effort rises above recovery pace. The skill-mobility block opens the shoulders and upper back for the handstand line and builds the pancake compression the L-sit and press need. The weekly skill-mobility block closes the class: wall shoulder openers, pancake compression lifts and bench thoracic extensions.
Bank five clean muscle-up pairs without grinding, then finish the assigned pull, dip, and bodyline work using each listed regression at form loss.
Alternate back-lever positions with controlled dragon negatives, then complete pulling and squats using the listed regressions whenever shape changes.
Complete the assigned row, dip, push-up, lateral-leg, and side-core stations at an even pace, using each listed regression before technique fades.

Exam day for classes L3:065-L3:083: handstand, handstand push-up, muscle-up, front lever, back lever, planche, dragon flag, pull-ups, dips, legs, core hold. One fresh set of each at the dose this block trained. Rest fully between tests, reach the number shown with clean form and stop at the first form break; the easier option doesn't count today. After the class the app asks which targets you reached.
Build wrist-tolerant straight-arm pressing from elevated support through frog and lean work, using each listed regression before alignment changes.
Complete five clean muscle-up pairs and the assigned bar-strength work with one rep in reserve, using the listed regression at the first slow turnover.

Use gentle back-lever entries, short holds, and dragon negatives to restore positions, taking the listed regression before recovery effort rises. The skill-mobility block opens the shoulders and upper back for the handstand line and builds the pancake compression the L-sit and press need. The weekly skill-mobility block closes the class: wall shoulder openers, pancake compression lifts and bench thoracic extensions.
Build back-lever control through measured partial skin-the-cat work, advanced-tuck holds and tuck entries, taking the listed regression at the first loss of shoulder position.
Strengthen the dragon-flag lowering line with bent-leg negatives, then reinforce trunk tension, pushing, and single-leg strength at controlled speed.
Rehearse one concise dose of every Level 3 skill goal, then finish with squat, row, and push-up fundamentals so the full sequence stays balanced without chasing fatigue.
Perform crisp muscle-up pairs while keeping one clean repetition in reserve, then develop the pull, dip, and leg strength that supports repeatable transitions.
Alternate front- and back-lever shapes in short exact holds, using the listed regression whenever the hips or shoulders leave the intended line, then retain pulling and squat basics.
Pair measured planche positions with pressing strength, keeping every lean and frog stand below form failure before finishing with dips and unilateral leg work.

Restore trunk and hip motion with easy dragon-flag mechanics, dead-bug control, and relaxed mobility; every repetition remains comfortably below strain. The skill-mobility block opens the shoulders and upper back for the handstand line and builds the pancake compression the L-sit and press need. The weekly skill-mobility block closes the class: wall shoulder openers, pancake compression lifts and bench thoracic extensions.
Practice repeatable assisted turnovers and low-bar transitions, then reinforce high pulling, straight-bar support strength, and controlled hanging knee raises.
Train brief advanced-tuck front-lever, back-lever, and dragon-flag positions in one precise session, ending each set before shape changes and using every listed regression immediately when needed.
Pair planche leans and forward-biased presses with deliberate dragon-flag negatives, maintaining exact positions before closing with controlled split squats.
Rehearse the strongest clean tuck and advanced-tuck lever positions accumulated so far, applying the listed regression as soon as the body line or shoulder position changes.

Wall slides, foot-assisted hangs, Cossack squats, trunk control and easy incline push-ups give the elbows and shoulders a day off before the Level 3 benchmark. Clean reps up to the number shown: stop at the first form break and note it; don't top up with the easier option.

Exam day for classes L3:085-L3:099: handstand, handstand push-up, muscle-up, front lever, back lever, planche, dragon flag, pull-ups, dips, legs, core hold. One fresh set of each at the dose this block trained. Rest fully between tests, reach the number shown with clean form and stop at the first form break; the easier option doesn't count today. After the class the app asks which targets you reached.
